title: Cat Water Fountain Stainless Steel 3.2L Capacity Dog Drinking Fountain Automatic Pet Feeding Watering Supplies
body_html: 1、Dual Spouts Type: The cat water fountain features a dual spout design that provides water supply for 2 pets simultaneously, ensuring all your pets stay hydrated. 2、Stainless Steel Structure: Made of stainless steel material, the water fountain is sturdy, strong, and easy to clean, delivering long term utility and easy maintenance. 3、Unique Water Flow Design: With its circular water flow design, this fountain engages pets' curiosity and encourages increased water intake, essential for their health and well being. 4、Automatic Circulating Filtration: This cat water fountain delivers automatic circulation and filtration, ensuring the water remains clean and healthy for your pets. 5、Silent Operations: With its quiet design, the water fountain does not disturb your pets, making it suitable for small pets like cats and dogs to use at all times, even during their rest time.Item Type: Pet Water FountainMaterial: Stainless SteelCapacity: 3.2L Size: Approx. 11x23cm / 4.33x9.05in1 x Pet Water Fountain1 x Cover1 x Filter1 x User Manual
